statement: Save selected elements as a module file (.mod) that can be placed in other projects as a hotlink and kept in sync.
superiority: Modules are first-class referenced assets with versioning and diff.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Create module from 10 elements; place into another project: 10 elements appear at the anchor point.

statement: Insert a module with chosen anchor, story, position and rotation, producing locked linked content in the host.
superiority: Placement transform is a single editable object and can be driven by script.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Placing at (5,5) with 30 degrees rotates and offsets all content consistently within 1e-9.

statement: Update placed modules when the source file changes, with options for conflicts with local edits.
superiority: Updates preview a diff before applying.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: A source change shows in the host after update and local overrides are listed.

statement: Convert hotlinked elements to ordinary editable elements.
superiority: Break keeps provenance metadata on elements.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: After break link the elements are editable and no link entry remains.

statement: Relink modules to a new file location or replace by another module.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Relink resolves path; update works.

statement: Dialog listing hotlinks with source path, status, update options and nested links.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Manager lists all links with correct statuses.

statement: Choose how attributes of the module are merged into host or kept separate.

source.ref: Hotlink Module: Hotlink as Reference or Merge

notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Merge mode adds attributes only when absent and reports the attributes added.

statement: Modules can contain other modules to a defined depth.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: A nested module resolves and updates through two levels.

statement: Map module stories to host stories even when counts differ.
superiority: Automatic mapping by elevation with manual override.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Module story 1 maps to host story 3 and elements land at the correct elevation.

statement: Hotlinked elements cannot be edited in the host but can be selected for reference.

source.ref: Hotlink Module: Hotlinked elements are locked

notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: An edit of a module element in the host is refused, while snapping to it works.

statement: Swap a module placement for another keeping position.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Swapping a module keeps the anchor and rotation of the placement.

statement: Missing files are reported, keeping last cached copy.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: A missing source shows a warning while the cached copy keeps displaying.

statement: Modules reused for typical rooms, units and facade.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Twenty instances of one module update together after a source edit.

statement: Relink modules to another file location or replace by another module.
superiority: Path resolution by stable project-relative ID, not absolute paths.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Relink resolves path and update works.

statement: Attributes of the source (surfaces, composites) are merged into the host by name with conflict rules.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Merge adds new attributes and leaves existing unchanged.

statement: Hotlinked elements cannot be edited in the host but can be referenced and snapped to.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: An edit attempt is refused; snap to a corner works.

statement: Link an IFC file as a reference model and update it when the file changes.

source.ref: Hotlink: IFC file as linked reference

superiority: Reference models share the same link manager as modules.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: IFC reference updates after the file changes.

statement: Missing source files are reported while the last cached copy remains.
notes: Archicad 29/30. Help chapter: Hotlink Modules. Deep link not fetched; chapter root only. Acceptance sketch: Cached copy displays and a warning lists the missing path.

statement: Create reusable modules for typical flats, bathrooms or facade bays and place many instances.

source.ref: Hotlink: module for typical rooms and facades
